speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical presentation of flesh-colored, pearly papules with central umbilication in a 2-year-old with daycare exposure is classic for Molluscum Contagiosum. DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum
